text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(It seems like they're trying to convey 
something. Just what could it be...?)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
What is that movement... I wonder... 
Groovy... no, energetic...?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: (That... counts as having a meal, yeah.)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(And then she danced... and pointed at me? 
Hmm... deducing from all this, Pearl-san's 
message is—)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Eat well, fill up with energy, and let's 
have a dance battle with me!" ...is it?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(Sorry, but count me out. Dancing with 
Pearl-san takes far too much out of you. 
...Mostly on a mental level.)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Allow me to follow Pearl-san's example 
and offer my response as well."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(“Thank you very much for the 
invitation... However, I must decline.”)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(“Let's do it another time.” 
............Did that get the message 
across?)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'll invite you again, Journey! When 
I do, let's dance!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...No. You're going to scream after all?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps thanks to the experience of 
conversing through body language, Dream 
Journey's running became sharper than ever 
from that day on.
